body:
Delivered the complete independent ACVC cluster B03 scientific review for the fixed task at c15227abeafa0cd58960750c0c9c47223b9d6a9f:

https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/867fdadff71eb9fac4a85b4e3cb44a0bfc55d033/docs/research/candidates/acvc/pro_packets/20260914_cluster_b03_scientific_review/archive/RESPONSE.md

The review finds no result-invalidating defect in the supplied B03 evidence and preserves both separate UP readings, all adverse outcomes and the three-observed-programme claim ceiling. It distinguishes larger relative gains from improved absolute F quality and recommends the narrowly framed longer-training use question over immediate fixed-512 confirmation for the current development objective, without selecting or authorizing a new experiment. It identifies one conditional reporting finding: the normal C/three-panel runner cost description remains hard-coded to 512-episode exposure and must be corrected if longer training is implemented. Increased exposure is not guaranteed stronger-policy competence or a causal training-duration result.

The response preserves the complete Portfolio reopening rationale and all historical evidence. DM responds to findings and chooses ordinary objects; Portfolio retains final direction-level interpretation. The task's exact per-path commits are retained: 781ab1199b299f1657e52398ab0981f77b53f464 for scientific records, 091c6725b149cd2dfa9665408cabee17b8f958e3 for inspected source and 4afaa06f705ec7bdb42e94a908e95eb89d819deb for methods. Verified commit 867fdadff71eb9fac4a85b4e3cb44a0bfc55d033 adds only the specified response file. No source, card, prior response, main or scientific state was changed; no code execution, new experiment or outcome reanalysis occurred.
